title: Implement supervised Mac Mini worker runtime
businessObjective: Operate a continuously available, bounded AI worker while Pi retains durable control-plane state and the worker or Codex gains no such authority.
technicalObjective: Implement the supervised Mac Mini worker consumer co-located with the Pi orchestration service and its durable state, with restart recovery, isolated task workspaces, bounded concurrency, task timeouts, cancellation, safe cleanup, and health reporting.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No production write, deployment, or live credential access is authorized.
Pi orchestration runs locally on the initial Mac Mini and retains logical ownership of durable scheduling, queue, retry, dead-letter, cancellation, and recovery state.
The initial Mac Mini co-locates Pi, durable state, worker, and adapter and is a potential single point of failure.
acceptanceCriteria: The worker consumes only bounded task envelopes and creates one collision-resistant isolated workspace per task.
Concurrency limits, task timeouts, cancellation, disk limits, and cleanup eligibility are enforced outside the model.
Process exit, device sleep, reboot, network loss, storage pressure, stale workspace, and worker unavailability preserve durable task state and fail closed to safe requeue or dead letter.
Pi queue and workflow records survive Pi-service, worker-process, and device restarts and are never stored as Codex process, session, output, or isolated-workspace state.
Supervision restarts the worker after reboot without automatically resuming an unverified production-impacting command.
Worker health reports sanitized provider and capacity state without exposing subscription or repository credentials.
Worker capacity is isolated from guest booking capacity and fails closed to bounded pause/requeue/dead letter before a hard resource limit.
Tier 0/shadow operation permits investigation, drafts, tests, branches, and authorized pull requests only; it cannot merge or deploy.
requiredChecks: supervision reboot sleep and process-failure recovery
workspace isolation collision retention and cleanup
concurrency timeout cancellation and storage bounds
solEscalationTriggers: Any ambiguity affects process supervision, reboot recovery, concurrency, timeout, cancellation, workspace isolation, cleanup, secrets, or durable task ownership.
Any request adds production execution, deployment, database, payment, booking, RLS, migration, or external side effects.
rollbackExpectations: Disable the worker consumer and revert its branch; preserve durable queue state, isolated workspace recovery data, and verification evidence.

stateTransitions.reason: Added by GOV-032 to isolate the continuously available worker from durable orchestration and authority.
